params.body:
## What happened

On 27 September 2026 one vehicle (#23121, dealer 444) was sent to Nederland Mobiel 25 times in five seconds. Every answer was HTTP 200 with `<status>error</status><message>De aangeleverde XML is corrupt</message>`: the dealer's description held a 0x10 control character, which XML 1.0 does not allow anywhere (`xmllint`: "PCDATA invalid Char value 16"). The platform only checked that the answer was XML, so:

- all 25 calls were logged as `ok = 1` in `partner_deliveries`;
- the vehicle kept `is_on_nederland_mobiel = 1`;
- the empty `<url/>` of the error answer decoded to an empty array and was written into the string column, so the sheet ended on `Error: Array to string conversion` with `nederland_mobiel_url = "[]"`.

## What changes

1. **The feed** (`XML::getXML`). The finished document goes through `XML::clean`, which removes every character XML 1.0 does not allow: C0 controls except tab, LF and CR, U+FFFE/U+FFFF, and anything that is not valid UTF-8 (lone surrogates). The characters are illegal in markup too, so cleaning the whole document covers every dealer-entered value (description, options, package, company name, address) and any value added later. The dealer address fields (street, city, zip, phone, email, homepage) are now also escaped for `&`, `<` and `>` (quotes kept as typed), like the company name already was: a homepage with `?a=1&b=2` produced the same "corrupt" answer. A document without such characters is byte for byte what it was; `NederlandMobielWireShapeTest` passes unchanged.
2. **The send path** (`OwnStockService::sendToNederlandMobiel`). An answer whose `status` is anything other than `ok` throws with the partner's message, so it goes through the existing failure path: flag off, `Error: De aangeleverde XML is corrupt` on the sheet (R P3-5.11). `nederland_mobiel_url` only ever gets a non-empty string, otherwise null. An answer without a `status` element is not judged (for example the sealed short-circuit).
3. **The trail** (`PartnerLog` row). Reading the answer moved into `readNederlandMobielAnswer` so it can be tested without the raw cURL call. The row is `ok` only when HTTP is 2xx and the partner said ok; on a refusal `error` holds the partner's message, and a non-2xx carries `HTTP <code>`. The delete path keeps its current behaviour on the vehicle; only its trail row is now honest.
4. **The created vehicle** (`VehicleObserver::created`). It passed `$dealer->id` to `listOnNederlandMobiel`; it now passes `$vehicle->id`. The docblock in `VehiclePublisher::listOnNederlandMobiel` that called the difference deliberate is replaced.

## Business rules

- New finding `docs/bedrijfsregels/bevindingen/2026-09-30-nederland-mobiel-weigering-telt-als-gelukt.md` (status opgelost, opgelost_in #864).
- R P3-15.1 now says the row records whether the partner accepted the vehicle (an HTTP 200 with an error status is a refusal, with the partner's reason), since the Werking screen will now show these refusals.
- New tests are tagged `@rule P3-5.1`, `P3-5.5`, `P3-5.11`, `P3-5.14`, `P3-15.1`.

## Tests

`tests/Feature/NederlandMobielRefusalIsAFailureTest.php` (8 tests): the character filter, a feed with control characters in description, package, name and address that parses, a refused answer ending on the sheet with the partner's words and no url, an ok answer with an empty `<url/>`, the trail rows for refusal, acceptance and HTTP 503, and a created vehicle whose dealer id equals another live vehicle's id being sent as itself. Seven of the eight fail on main.

Full suite locally: 2418 tests green. PHPStan: no errors. Pint clean on the new test file.

## Known follow-up (not in this PR)

Every processed photo fires `updated` on the vehicle, and each one sends it to Nederland Mobiel again: that is where the 25 sends in five seconds came from. A refusal now switches the flag off, so later photo updates outside the sheet's own save no longer resend a refused vehicle; the resend per photo for an accepted vehicle stays as it is.
params.title: Nederland Mobiel: a refused feed is a failure, and one control character no longer corrupts it
